geography: United States (ACADIA sells only in the U.S.)

launch_evidence.quote: We launched NUPLAZID in the United States in May 2016.

search_log: Listed every filing of ACADIA Pharmaceuticals (CIK 1070494) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks carrying item 2.02 (2016-05 to 2026-11) and every 10-Q/10-K (crawl_8k_acadia.json, crawl_periodic_acadia.json); parsed every table row.

2016Q2-2023Q1: row 'Product sales, net' of each quarter's own earnings release (8-K Ex. 99.1), three-months column. NUPLAZID was ACADIA's only commercial product until DAYBUE (April 2023); the 10-K for 2023 product table prints NUPLAZID 2022 517,235 = Product sales, net 2022 517,235.

2023Q2 on: row 'NUPLAZID' of the net product sales by product table in each 10-Q; Q4 = 10-K full year less 10-Q nine months. ACADIA's earnings releases print no NUPLAZID quarterly row except the 2026-02-25 release (GAAP NUPLAZID Net Sales Q4 2025 174.4 million, matching the derived 174.356).
Checks: Q4 2016-2022 releases print full-year Product sales, net equal to the sum of the four quarters (verified by verify_staged_manifests); unit is thousands as each table header declares.
